title: Khamoosh na ho baap se baate karo akbar
body:
Haaye...
Haye jawan laal ko maqtal se jab uthake chale
Hussain rote rahe aur pisar se kehte rahe
<<MINI>>
Khamosh na ho baap se baatein karo akbar
Khamosh na ho baap se baatein karo akbar..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
Hum tum ko mila denge..
Hum tum ko mila denge phupijaan se jaakar
1. Aye laal kaleje mein abhi dard to hoga
nikla hai lahu itna badan sard to hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
tum chup ho to chalte hai..(2)
mere qalb pe khanjar
2. Qadmo ki taraf se hai uthaye hue baba aur sar ki taraf se hai sambhale hue Zahra
ankho'n ko zara kholke dekho to yeh manzar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Tum khoon ugalte ho to bhar jata hai chullu
batlao karein zabt kaha tak mere aasu
beta nikal aayega kaleja mera bahar
4. Darya pe gaye honge jo ladte hue beta
<<DIVIDER>>
jaldi se batao mera phat-ta hai kaleja
kis haal mein hai lasha e abbas e dilawar
5. Tum khud bhi samajhte ho yeh majboori meri hai
ahista jo chalta hun kamar tooti hui hai
<<DIVIDER>>
thoda sa safar baaqi hai..(2)
himmat karo dilbar
6. Beta hume maidan ki rudaad sunao
kya haal hai ab pyaas ka baba ko batao
<<DIVIDER>>
anguthi dahan kyu nikal aayi hai bahar
7. Maathe se pasina to abhi saaf kiya hai
kya zakhm ki takleef ne muh khol diya hai
saansein kyu meri jaan nahi aati barabar
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Sheh bole takallum ke utho aagaya khaima
seene se zara haath hata lo mere beta
is haal mein dekhengi to, mar jayegi madar
Khamosh na ho..
<<MINI>>
Khamosh na ho baap se baatein karo akbar
